Name: The Marsh King
Description: Something is holding the reed beds. Go and take them back.
Quest Text: The Marsh King has taken the reed beds and he will not give them back for asking. Beat his side in his own mud and the marsh is ours again.

Name: Clear the Reeds
Description: A short run. Good for a first haul and a full basket of reed.
Quest Text: Two waves through the shallows and the Reed Warden at the end. Bring back a full basket for the Brewer.

Name: The Ash Tyrant
Description: It sits at the centre of the burn and it has been there a long time.
Quest Text: At the centre of the burn the Ash Tyrant has never lost a match. Somebody has to be first.

Name: The Slag Run
Description: Iron for the taking, if you can get past what is guarding it.
Quest Text: Iron for the forge, if you can get past what is guarding it. Three waves of it.

Name: The Hollow Mother
Description: Nobody who has gone this deep has come back with a straight story.
Quest Text: Down in the old works, below everything. Nobody who went this deep came back with a straight story.

Name: The Brewer's Errand
Description: ROUND AN - THE TUTORIAL'S BOUNTY. Koch drank the Brewery dry, so the Brewer needs reed. One wave, then the Reed Warden. Only on the board in the Tutorial (flag:tut_morning).
Quest Text: Koch drank the Brewery dry. The Brewer needs reed: one wave through the marsh, then the Reed Warden. Bring back ten bundles.
